seo.metaDescription: Milestones of the SBX 2.0 preview site, documentation refreshes, and the NHA and NRCeS material the corpus reproduces.

page.title: What changed on this site and in the documentation
page.intro: Milestones of the SBX 2.0 preview site, refreshes of the documentation corpus, and pointers to the NHA and NRCeS material the corpus reproduces. Nothing here is a press release.
page.featuredTitle: Documentation corpus refreshed: 64 pages in 12 chapters
page.featuredDescription: The reader and the assistant now run on the corpus built on 22 August 2026 from NHA’s published material: claim flows, FHIR references, protocol headers, codes and troubleshooting.
page.upcomingNote: No developer sessions are scheduled. When one is, it is announced here.
page.enquiriesText: This is the SBX 2.0 preview of the sandbox portal. Questions about its content go to the sandbox desk through the application form; the National Health Authority’s own press contacts are published on its official site.

items.title: Documentation corpus refreshed: 64 pages in 12 chapters
items.body: Built on 22 August 2026 from NHA’s published material: claim flows, FHIR references, protocol headers, codes and troubleshooting. The reader, the search index and the assistant all read this set.

items.title: Learning path launched: two tracks, fourteen chapters with checks
items.body: NHCX fundamentals for newcomers and the API implementation journey for integrators, each chapter ending in a short check. The path lives in the DevTools console alongside the API catalogue, with progress kept there.

items.title: HCX DevTools page: per-platform builds with SHA-256 digests
items.body: The nhcx-adapter release is listed per operating system and architecture with its checksums, and the page recommends the build for the machine it is read on.

items.title: Sandbox application form, API catalogue, playbook and service status
items.body: Apply for sandbox access and look the application up later; browse the 63-endpoint catalogue; follow the playbook per persona; watch component health on the status page.

items.title: NHA integrator FAQ v1.1 reproduced in the corpus
items.body: The Commonly Asked Questions for NHCX APIs (registry codes, 401s, header formats, callbacks, the dummy payer and the PMJAY-specific rules) dated 14 August 2026 and marked approval pending in the source.

items.title: NRCeS FHIR profiles: why NHCX mandates them over base R4
items.body: What NRCeS publishes, which resources are profiled for the health-claim eObjects, and how to validate a payload against the ndhm.in package.

items.title: The NHA workflow status sheet, mapped to protocol headers
items.body: Every x-hcx-workflow_id (provider-initiated and payer-response codes) with its protocol status and NRCeS outcome.

items.title: Participant onboarding guidelines: the two-stage path
items.body: Sandbox registration, integration, certification, then production registration and go-live, with the registry APIs and identifiers used at each step.

items.title: Sandbox exit checklists for providers and payers
items.body: The 13 provider and 15 payer use cases assessed at certification, the exit criteria, and what changes at go-live.
